evidence.gate: For every case, path (fp32, bf16) and tensor (o, dq, dk, dv, dg, dbeta), against a float64 run of the executed fallback source: the kernel's largest element error exceeds the FP32 fallback's by at most 2u max|ref|, and its relative Frobenius error exceeds the fallback's by at most 2u, u the unit roundoff of the path's dtype (the two implementations' final roundings); no non-finite value where the fallback has none; and two kernel runs are bit-equal.

scope: Exact retained historical numerical artifact. Regression tests project its case roster as metadata only; no fresh GPU result or qualification is manufactured.
